problem: Find Cartesian coordinates of the point of intersection of the polar curve $r=5$ with the positive $x$-axis.
worked_solution:
The polar curve $r=5$ is a circle of radius $5$ centered at the origin. It crosses the positive $x$-axis at the point $(5,0),$ as shown below. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14039331/assets/54e01fed14e44783dd13a1d7163688ab4e2c788997697dd3ae26fe8e00dac47d.png)

Therefore, the point of intersection is $(5,0).$
